an11.16:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Ānando Vesāliyaṃ viharati Beluvagāmake.
an11.16:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Dasamo gahapati Aṭṭhakanāgaro Pāṭaliputtaṃ anuppatto hoti kenaci-deva karaṇīyena.
an11.16:2.1: Atha kho Dasamo gahapati Aṭṭhakanāgaro yena Kukkuṭārāmo yena aññataro bhikkhu ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca
an11.16:2.2: ‘kahaṃ nu kho bhante āyasmā Ānando etarahi viharati,
an11.16:2.3: dassanakāmā hi mayaṃ bhante āyasmantaṃ Ānandan' ti?
an11.16:2.4: ‘Eso gahapati āyasmā Ānando Vesāliyaṃ viharati Beluvagāmake' ti. 2.
an11.16:3.1: Atha kho Dasamo gahapati Aṭṭhakanāgaro Pāṭaliputte taṃ karaṇīyaṃ tīretvā yena Vesālibeluvagāmako yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Dasamo gahapati Aṭṭhakanāgaro āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca
an11.16:3.2: ‘atthi nu kho bhante Ānanda tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo samma-d-akkhāto, yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī' ti?
an11.16:3.3: ‘Atthi gahapati tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo samma-d-akkhāto, yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī' ti.
an11.16:4.1: ‘Katamo ca pana bhante Ānanda tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo samma-d-akkhāto, yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī' ti? 3.
an11.16:4.2: Idha gahapati bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an11.16:4.4: ‘idaṃ pi kho paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ,
an11.16:4.5: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ, tad aniccaṃ nirodhadhamman' ti pajānāti.
an11.16:4.6: So tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti;
an11.16:4.7: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, ten' eva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an11.16:4.8: Ayaṃ pi kho gahapati tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo samma-d-akkhāto, yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti. 4.
an11.16:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ gahapati bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ . . . pe . . .
an11.16:5.5: ‘idam pi kho catutthaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ,
an11.16:5.6: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ, tad aniccaṃ nirodhadhamman' ti pajānāti.
an11.16:5.7: So tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti;
an11.16:5.8: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, ten' eva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an11.16:5.9: Ayam pi kho gahapati tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo samma-dakkhāto, yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti. 5.
an11.16:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ gahapati bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbatthatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an11.16:6.4: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ, tad aniccaṃ nirodhadhamman' ti pajānāti.
an11.16:6.5: So tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti;
an11.16:6.6: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, ten' eva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an11.16:6.7: Ayam pi kho gahapati tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammad-akkhāto, yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti. 6.
an11.16:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ gahapati bhikkhu karuṇāsahagatena cetasā . . . pe . . .
an11.16:7.3: cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ.
an11.16:7.4: Iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbatthatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an11.16:7.7: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ, tad aniccaṃ nirodhadhamman' ti pajānāti.
an11.16:7.8: So tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti;
an11.16:7.9: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, ten' eva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an11.16:7.10: Ayam pi kho gahapati tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo samma-d-akkhāto, yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti. 7.
an11.16:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ gahapati bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso' ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an11.16:8.4: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tad aniccaṃ nirodhadhamman' ti pajānāti.
an11.16:8.5: So tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti;
an11.16:8.6: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, ten' eva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an11.16:8.7: Ayam pi kho gahapati tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo samma-d-akkhāto, yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti. 8.
an11.16:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ gahapati bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇan' ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati . . .
an11.16:9.2: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī' ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an11.16:9.5: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ, tad aniccaṃ nirodhadhamman' ti pajānāti.
an11.16:9.6: So tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti;
an11.16:9.7: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, ten' eva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an11.16:9.8: Ayam pi kho gahapati tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo samma-d-akkhāto, yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī ti. 9.
an11.16:10.1: Evaṃ vutte Dasamo gahapati Aṭṭhakanāgaro āyasmantam Ānandaṃ etad avoca:--
an11.16:10.2: Seyyathā pi bhante Ānanda puriso ekaṃ nidhimukhaṃ gavesanto saki-d-eva ekādasa nidhimukhāni adhigaccheyya,
an11.16:10.3: evam eva kho ahaṃ bhante ekaṃ amatadvāraṃ gavesanto saki-d-eva ekādasannaṃ amatadvārānaṃ alatthaṃ sevanāya.
an11.16:10.4: Seyyathā pi bhante purisassa agāraṃ ekādasadvāraṃ so tasmiṃ agāre āditte ekamekena dvārena sakkuṇeyya attānaṃ sotthiṃ kātuṃ,
an11.16:10.5: evam eva kho ahaṃ bhante imesaṃ ekādasannaṃ amatadvārānaṃ ekamekena amatadvārena sakkuṇissāmi attānaṃ sotthiṃ kātuṃ.
an11.16:10.6: Ime hi nāma bhante aññatitthiyā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesissanti,
an11.16:10.7: kiṃ panāhaṃ āyasmato Ānandassa pūjaṃ na karissāmī ti? 10.
an11.16:11.1: Atha kho Dasamo gahapati Aṭṭhakanāgaro Vesālikañ ca Pāṭaliputtakañ ca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi
an11.16:11.2: ekamekañ ca bhikkhuṃ paccekadussayugena acchādesi āyasmantañ ca Ānandaṃ ticīvarena
an11.16:11.3: āyasmato ca Ānandassa pañcasataṃ vihāraṃ kārāpesī
